LOOK: Residents and scavengers scoured for whatever was usable on Tuesday, August 19, after a fire hit a residential area in Brgy. Agdao Proper, Davao City.

Investigators are still determining the cause of the fire that razed at least 70 houses and affected nearly 300 residents on Monday. 

📸: Keith Bacongco | MB
